## Skill checklist

- [ ] Commands are copied from a run that completed successfully
- [ ] `SKILL.md` states what it was tested on (data, versions, resources, runtime)
- [ ] Environment setup is included and versions are pinned
- [ ] Output validation steps are included
- [ ] `requires-network`, `requires-secrets`, `requires-gpu` and `scheduler` are accurate
- [ ] A trigger eval is added under `evals/`
- [ ] `aiscientist-skill sync` and `aiscientist-skill validate` pass
- [ ] For changes to an existing skill: `metadata.version` bumped and `CHANGELOG.md` updated
